Name: Custom Summer Sounds
Author: Auriala
Description:
If you're like me you hate the buzzing sound during the summer but still wanted to hear the birds.

[b][u]Update:[/u][/b] New Content Patcher version is now out! Works with 1.6 Update! This is set as the main download file.


[b][u]OLD Custom Music Version:[/u]
[/b]
Well, this version of the mod uses Custom Music by ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42440425]Platonymous[/url] to replace the original summer sounds with a custom one that changes the buzzing to cicadas instead while still letting you hear the birds. For older versions of Stardew. [b][u]DO NOT USE THIS WITH NEW 1.6 UPDATE![/u][/b]

[b]**Please do not re-upload this mod as your own or upload it to any other site! Thank you!**[/b]
